title: Hall layouts and playing at the Pelican with Kid Rene
summary: Bandstand versus balcony halls; Dawson and Kid Rene played the Pelican, starting on the front gallery.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Uh, you say it was just a small hall, Eddie?
Yes, it wasn't such a large place.
Was it one of those halls where the band goes up on the balcony, or did it have a little bandstand?
No, it had a bandstand. Uh-huh. It didn't have no balcony, no...
Small hall, eh? But it wasn't up in there, up in the...
It wasn't behind the stairs, up on the balcony, wasn't up there?

No, no. Oh, that was the Pelican, like, was on Rampard and Gravia. That was, that had a stairs that go up. Balcony in front. Yeah. That's where we, uh, me and Kid Rene was playing it. We played there. I played there with Rene at the Pelican. On Rampard between, uh, Neb Gravia. Yes, I know by Neb Gravia. Well, we had, well, Beansy was running that place. But they had a front porch down on the gallery, you see? And we used to go out and play a couple of numbers out on that front gallery before we'd go in and play, you know, the dance style, the dance style. The avatar.
